text_simplified: Children are among Allah's greatest blessings and the adornment of worldly life, and the beauty of this adornment is only completed through religion and good character. This blessing is a trust about which parents will be questioned on the Day of Resurrection, as the Messenger ﷺ said: "All of you are shepherds and responsible for your flock: the leader is a shepherd and is responsible for his flock, and a man in his family is a shepherd and is responsible for his flock" (Sahih al-Bukhari 2409). Ibn al-Qayyim (may Allah have mercy on him) explained that neglecting to teach children the obligations and Sunnahs of religion when they are young is the greatest cause of their corruption and loss when they grow old.
